name: io.github.mark1russell7/polite-crawler
title: polite-crawler
description: A polite crawler for agents: obeys robots.txt, fetches each page once, finds and verifies quotes.

environmentVariables.name: POLITE_CRAWLER_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The folder of the store. The default is ~/.polite-crawler.

environmentVariables.name: POLITE_CRAWLER_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL for the From header of each request.

environmentVariables.name: POLITE_CRAWLER_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set it to 1 to let the crawler fetch loopback, private and link-local addresses. The default refuses them.

environmentVariables.name: POLITE_CRAWLER_ALLOW_USER_PROVIDED
environmentVariables.description: Set it to 1 to let user_provided read a page that refuses AI input when the client cannot ask the user to confirm.
